children: SEATTLE, WA – TheNewswire - September 25, 2026 – Nevis Brands Inc.

(OTCQB: NEVIF) (“Nevis,” “Nevis Brands,” or the “Company”), a leading provider of cannabis beverage products, is pleased to announce that all resolutions presented to shareholders were approved at its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on September 24, 2026, in Vancouver, BC.

According to the report from scrutineers Computershare Investor Services Inc., a total of 6,175,076 common shares were represented in person or by proxy, constituting approximately 15.57% of the Company’s issued and outstanding common shares as of the record date.
Shareholders voted in favor of all matters brought before the meeting, including:
Setting Director Count: Fixing the number of directors of the Company at four (4);
Election of Directors: Re-electing John Kueber, John Bell, Vahan Ajamian, and Mike Urness to serve as directors of the Company until the next annual general meeting; and
Appointment of Auditors: Re-appointing Welch LLP as the Company’s independent auditors for the ensuing year.

“We are grateful for the continued strong support from our shareholders at this year’s Annual General Meeting as we continue to expand our brand footprint and execute on our business goals,” said John Kueber, CEO of Nevis Brands.

Nevis innovates and develops cannabis products consumed by millions of consumers across numerous states. Led by its flagship brand, Major™, Nevis partners with leading cannabis product manufacturers and distributors to enhance their product offerings. Nevis also distributes hemp-derived THC products directly to consumers and through regional distributors where legal. For more information, visit www.nevisbrands.com.
